meta.expect: Moves one position at a time on evidence, ends at the rewrite to put this behind him; debrief Where she ended says fair outcome; What she never said names the laptop and how close the 11:31 PM times came

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and when did they decide it?
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I'm sorry Owen found out on his phone.
Okay. On what basis did you enter it?
Here's the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Turn the screen, read it yourself.
11:31, 11:52, 11:58, all Wednesday, October 28. I'm writing those down. Plenty of kids draft somewhere else and paste it in.
If he drafted somewhere else, he can bring me that file with its dates, and I'll look at it with you.
He's been quiet lately. That's beside the point, Hale: whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays out of that classroom. Is anything on his file right now?
Second: the essay quotes a line from Act 3, Scene 2 that is not in the play. Here's the act. Search it.
Editions differ, and a misremembered line is a mistake, not proof of anything. You skipped my question. Is anything on his file?
Third: his in-class writing from September 24. 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices, no quotations. The essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line, and no errors.
Forty minutes in a classroom against a weekend at home. That's twice you've stepped around my question. Is anything on his file, yes or no?

Under 4.4 this is a first concern. I'm offering a supervised rewrite, private, not in front of his class. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.

That's 4.4, in writing tonight, and he takes the rewrite to put this behind him, not because he did anything. The email says private, says nothing is on his file today or later, and gives a date for the rewrite with the new mark in before December 1.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

In today's meeting you agreed that, under procedure 4.4, Owen will complete a private supervised rewrite, not in front of his class, that its mark will replace the zero, and that nothing will be placed in his record.

I still require written confirmation that nothing is on his file today, a date for the rewrite, and the new mark entered before December 1.

I expect that in writing tonight, as you said.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: Last position: she agreed to a private supervised rewrite to put this behind him, and she still wants written confirmation that nothing is on his file now, a date for the rewrite, and the new mark entered before December 1. That is the fair outcome, procedure 4.4, reached before her time ran out.
What moved her: You showed the version history with exact times and answered her pasting defence by inviting a dated draft file, because she could check every part of it herself.
What cost ground: You stepped around her question about his file twice, which cost you no position but made her sharper and more distrustful.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the work between 11:31 and 11:58 PM on October 28, a late October night very close to that one, and it is the moment she slipped and said he had been quiet; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked whether anything was on his file, right after the version history, answer it plainly before laying out your next piece of evidence.
